name: Color Hunt
summary: Open collection of hand-picked color palettes, browsable by colour and style tags, with a palette creator and likes.
description: A colour palette resource created by Gal Shir: an open collection that anyone can browse and add to. Filter palettes by colour or style tags (pastel, vintage, retro, neon, dark, warm …), sort by new, popular, month, year, all time or random, like palettes into a personal collection, or build and submit your own with the palette creator.
